id./param/scenario/cs/b_110_cs_100.pack|cs_: "...{var:1}, I'm sorry. Because I let my guard down, the monsters caught me off guard and took Erik.
"What are you saying, Father? Attacked by such frightening fellows, you're lucky just to be alive.
"We heard you were outside town and rushed over worried. Thank goodness you're safe.
"Damn! They took every person with Gold Fever, one after another...
"They only cared about valuables. Like appraising whether they could sell our lives dear... damn.
"...But Erik carried nothing valuable and wasn't infected.
"Yet those monsters took him without hesitation, as if they knew him from the start.
"Their way of speaking, their gestures... could they really be...?
"...Truth is, that crossed my mind too. So you reached the same thought.
"Now that you say it... But is that possible?
"Those gold-hungry monsters... we recognize their words and habits.
"...Yes, they resemble the Vikings who put in at this port. If so, they might know Erik.
"Back then their hideout was in a cave just offshore by ship. If we go there, maybe..."
